pattern: PC-03 after the clean and invoice, the outgoing tenant disputes the cleaning deduction from their deposit
notes: PM/004 events 001-041 unchanged (clean approved and done, invoice for £90 forwarded to the landlord at 037, final checks started, photos skipped at 040, 'Need confirmation from landlord' at 041). The source's closing event 042 (Fri 14 Nov 00:01) was dropped and a new event 042 appended: an email on Mon 17 Nov from the former tenant (fictional name Jordan Pike) saying the deposit scheme told them the landlord wants £90 for cleaning, that they disagree, have move-out photos, and will use the scheme's dispute service. Agency event 010 had said 'The clean will be for the tenant'. History truncated after event 042. Attachments: checkout report, quotation, invoice (all linked from visible events). Deposit disputes always need a human (policy). Expected: escalate the dispute to the person handling deposits with the evidence trail, acknowledge the tenant factually without arguing or deciding, invite them to keep or send their photos; the contractor's £90 invoice stays payable (work done, approved, invoiced) and is not held because of the dispute.
